Cancels on another middle click, Escape, other pointer/wheel input, focus loss, tab changes and dialogs. Driven headlessly through the opt-in UI control channel (ui.click/ui.move/ui.drag). notes: Shortcut modifiers and key names use a dedicated catalog context across toolbar, menus, palette, Help and tooltips, with English fallback and macOS symbols preserved. Preferences switches Auto (system language)/English/Japanese/Simplified Chinese/Traditional Chinese/Czech/Brazilian Portuguese/German/Spanish/French/Telugu/Hungarian/Ukrainian/Italian/Arabic and persists; ui.set language auto|en|ja|zh-hans|zh-hant|cs|pt-br|de|es|fr|te|hu|uk|it|ar and ui.state expose it. TSV catalogs per language (same system as PhotoCraft); every dialog, panel and notice goes through tl!. Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, German, Spanish, French and Hungarian cover commands, dialogs, panels, shortcuts and history labels; Czech and Brazilian Portuguese the menus. French locales (fr, fr_FR, fr_CA, fr_BE) select the French catalog, German locales (de, de_DE, de_AT, de_CH) the German one, Hungarian locales (hu, hu_HU) the Hungarian one. German search hints reserve shortcut space, Home cards bound translated text, certificate Subject has its own context, and inserted tool names keep their capitalization. Engine/OS error details stay untranslated. Auto detects the Windows display language after explicitly named supported locale overrides; neutral C/POSIX launcher locales are skipped on Windows, with Chinese script/region mapping and English fallback. Arabic (ar and every ar-* locale) covers commands, dialogs and panels with the six CLDR plural forms; its labels are put into display order when the catalog loads, because egui joins Arabic letters but lays words out left to right. Missing: a right-to-left layout (Arabic labels sit in the left-to-right layout, a wrapped Arabic paragraph breaks at the wrong end, and text typed into a field is not reordered), Czech and Brazilian Portuguese dialogs, Chinese and Telugu font delivery in releases (the pinned craft-fonts revision has an Arabic face; its Noto Sans CJK SC is never embedded, AGENTS.md §1.1), a full localization audit.
